summary: Seabridge Gold filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) announcing its Q1 2026 interim financial statements, MD&A, and report to shareholders. The filing is a routine periodic earnings disclosure containing standard financial results: net loss of $6.6 million ($0.06 per share) versus net profit of $10.6 million ($0.11 per share) in Q1 2025. Notable highlights mention strategic objectives for KSM and a spin-out of Courageous Lake, but no definitive transaction, board recommendation, or binding agreement is described. There are no deal terms, price, premium, or regulatory triggers. This is a standard quarterly update, not a special situation event.
